ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle B= 90^\circ$, $AB=2$, and $BC=4$, the quadrilateral $ADEC$ is a square. What is the area of the square $ADEC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle B= 90^\circ$, AB=2, BC=4,\\
thus $AC=\sqrt{AB^{2}+BC^{2}}$\\
$=\sqrt{2^{2}+4^{2}}$\\
$=2\sqrt{5}$\\
Therefore, the area of the square ADEC is $\boxed{20}$
